_comment: Durable evidence that a specific commit satisfied the repository's guarantees under stated conditions (ADR-0032). Append-only: failed runs are recorded too, because a manifest holding only successes claims a platform that never failed to certify. Nothing here declares a verdict — `satisfied` is derived from the gates and scenarios below, and `is_certified` additionally requires that the recorded conditions still match the repository, so a rendering-protocol bump or a prompt re-release expires a certification without anyone editing this file. Written only by `make certify`.
